title: Treatise on the Shield-Crushing Club
summary: Teaches a Champion to break shields and guards by driving full-meridian qi through the club's head.

title: Canon of the Falling Heartwood
summary: Describes how a Xiantian cultivator spreads qi along the club's grain and lets each stroke fall like a felled trunk.

title: Handbook of the Armour-Bruising Club
summary: Shows how qi-driven club blows send shock through plate and mail to injure the body inside.

title: The Long Reckoning of Blunt Wood
summary: Gathers the heavy field-driven strokes by which a Xiantian fighter overwhelms several opponents with one club.

title: Treatise of the Paired-Track Cudgel
summary: Teaches the dual-track cudgel, where a body-track blow and a qi-track blow strike in matched pairs.

title: Hawk-Stoop Cudgel Canon
summary: Teaches a Xiantian cultivator to drop upon an opponent from above like a hawk, with the cudgel as its talon.

title: Manual of the Azure Basin Club
summary: Sets out the club forms of the azure basin schools, where blows gather and pool before they are released.

title: The Twin-Current Club Canon
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to run two currents of qi down one club, as a river runs in two channels.

title: Wind-Sworn Cudgel Treatise
summary: Teaches a Champion the cudgel forms sworn to the wind, quick in their entry and plain in their weight.

title: Plateau-Edge Club Canon
summary: Describes how a Xiantian cultivator fights at the plateau's edge, driving foes back with club blows that hold ground.

title: Oath-Bearing Club Manual
summary: Gathers the club forms of those who swear an oath and take a bearing before every exchange.

title: The Bearing and the Gale Club Canon
summary: Teaches a Xiantian fighter to keep a held bearing through a gale, turning the wind's push into club strokes.
